candidate_pool: Baseline, final WeightedMean, every actual Gaussian from all4iterations =258 sequences; preserve source and aliases; uniform unique nonBaseline FIRST controls L2>1e-5

methods.C: Uniform random actual nonBaseline first control
methods.D: Reward-only argmax over the entire SAME captured pool
methods.E: Independent native RQ final2 replication, MUST equal B
methods.F: Native proposed Mean protected by development-only frozen finite margin
methods.G: Supplement: same-pool RQ argmax, paired with D to isolate terminal-Q from pool eligibility

random_seed_rule: Independent default_rng(20261119 + scene*31 + seed), never global environment RNG
h1: Exactly one action, then original B feedback to native done
closed: Whole episode, replan and execute first action every period; A originalSAC,B originalNative,C evidence-selected opt-in change
unreachable: If original episode ends before fixed50, retain full episode, mark origin unreachable, no map/origin replacement

decision_rules.reward_case: D must beat Native B and matched-pool G in paired95%CI, no crash/OOR mean increase,positive gain on >=8/12maps; reward gain vsA CI lower>0
decision_rules.margin_case: F-vsA paired gain CI lower>0, no crash/OOR mean increase,nonzero physical replacement; frozen margin never retuned
decision_rules.unsupported: Otherwise implement opt-in baseline guard with replacement_supported=false; deny unsupported replacement, explicitly protection not performance success
decision_rules.no_gaussian_change: Positive finite old oracle already proves some coverage; no evidence supporting new samples/std/rho/iterations
decision_rules.screening_note: New maps independent of all older studies. H1 informs a predeclared mechanism branch; same-map subsequent closed-loop is SCREENING, not untouched final validation

latency_probe: After all jobs: isolated first2maps seed1 pre50,5warmup+50full calls/method, no probe controls executed; closed shared-load timings separately
acceptance: Success>A,crash/OOR not higher,positive map-paired discounted gain and route not lower,beyond one map/seed,H1gain better thanrandom,physicalreplacement>0;targetfullcycleP95<=100ms
